newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartport raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartport raised to buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Tuesday it raised its rating on Heartport Inc to a buy from a hold.
-- Heartport has said it accelerated the U.S. launch of its Port-Access minimally invasive cardiac surgery systems.
-- "We view this event as very positive news as it should allow Heartport to accelerate its revenue ramp-up substantially," Dain Bosworth analyst Sanjiv Arora said in a report.
-- Heartport said it received orders from more than 50 high-volume U.S. cardiac surgery cetnres for its systems.

-- "While we have not formally revised our earnings model, our initial thoughts are that the acceleration of U.S. launch could add approximately $6-10 million to our 1997 revenue estimate of $18.4 million," Arora said.
